selection.reason: No candidate achieved the required validation gain, so the simpler baseline was retained.

metrics.name: poisson_deviance
metrics.definition: Mean Poisson deviance on the untouched chronological test window. Lower is better.

metrics.name: top_k_capture
metrics.definition: Share of observed test incidents captured by the highest-ranked 10% of aggregate rows.

metrics.name: mae
metrics.definition: Mean absolute count error for this aggregate slice.

spatial_displacement.definition: Cells ranked by mean absolute error on the untouched test window; this is an error audit, not an enforcement recommendation.

limitations: Synthetic fixture metrics are illustrative and must not be presented as measured system performance.
